_comment: Calibrated alert-reality model: logit P(real) = intercept + b*log(score_min) + c*log(chi2) + d*log(mfsnr_min). Fit on night 20260630's OWN false-positive population (pair-consistent injections into that night's repeat-pointing regions; 11,663 labelled 2-visit alerts, 936 real / 10,727 false), cross-validated by pointing group. See ADCNN/calibration/ALERT_RANKING.md.
_caveat: Positives are SYNTHETIC (add_trails Gaussian-PSF renders); the null is real but the signal is not. Re-fit per night before treating as universal.
_domain_note: Features are CLIPPED to this range before evaluating the model, and were clipped the same way when fitting. A logistic fit is only meaningful over its support; mf_snr in particular carries a numerics blowup (degenerate panel MAD sigma -> values to ~1e9 present even inside the labelled set) which both skewed the unclipped fit and, at inference, drove P(real)->1 on corrupt panels through log(). Clipping fixed both: AUC 0.9890 -> 0.9910.
